source_fbref_teams.assessment: Limited value. Season aggregates only, not match-level. Useful for team calibration but not for direct feature addition.

walkforwardState.keyProblem: All xG features are rolling averages only. No match-level xG anywhere.

liftAnalysis.currentXGFeatures: Rolling averages from walkforward (smoothed, no match variance)
liftAnalysis.proposedUnderstatFeatures: 15 new features including match-level xG, npxG, deep, PPDA, xGA
liftAnalysis.reasoning: Understat xG direction accuracy is 57.9% (8% better than coin flip). Features are orthogonal to rolling averages. PPDA and deep entries are completely new signal dimensions not present anywhere in current 81-feature set.

strategicPlan.phase1: Fix v7 preprocessor SQL queries and merge pipeline
strategicPlan.phase3: Train LightGBM + DeepNN ensemble with 885K samples
strategicPlan.phase4: Weighted ensemble optimization and seed averaging
criticalBugsFound: v7 preprocessor queries non-existent columns (home_shot_count, away_shot_count)
v7 preprocessor falls back to np.random.uniform when data missing (adds noise)
v7 preprocessor uses synthetic team names (Team_0, Team_1) making merge impossible
v7 preprocessor ignores npxG, deep, PPDA, xGA features
modelArchitecture: Weighted ensemble: learned via Bayesian optimization

residualRisks: Team name mismatch between Understat and sofa data may reduce merge success below expected 9097 matches. Mitigation: use team_name_mapping table (2548 rows).

Understat only covers 2020-2026 top-5 leagues. ~50% of training data (pre-2020, non-top-5) will have 0 for Understat features. Mitigation: use 0 fillna and let model learn xG is unavailable for those matches.
v7 preprocessor log shows 64+ constant columns that consume memory. Mitigation: VarianceThreshold with threshold=0.0 to remove them before training.
Training time will increase ~2x with added features and 885K samples. Budget ~4-6 hours for ensemble training.
